The '''1993–94 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 58th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 22 August 1993 and ended on 24 April 1994. [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] won their third consecutive and 11th Greek title.
